plainText:
Breath of the Dragonair Part 2 (Japanese: VS ハクリュー【中編】 VS (Part Two)) is the 61st chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 21st chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
The story opens with the contestants of the surfing contest being pulled into the sea by a raging , under the control of Lance. Dragonair then uses to destroy half of Vermilion City. Lance shouts to someone to come out but is not answered, so he moves on. Yellow plans to chase Lance with , returning .
 
The story then cuts to the battle between Blasty and . The command-bubble almost reaches Blasty, but is popped by Hitmonlee. Hitmonlee uses its stretching body to wrap up Blasty. Blasty uses to hide the next command-bubble. The command reaches Blasty, telling it to use a made-up move (OX□♥○), with which Blasty punches the foe with its cannons. Hitmonlee is knocked out, and Green realizes that this was a decoy.

The story cuts back to Yellow. Pika's tail gets and Pika is thrown to Dragonair with the help of Dody's powerful legs, whilst the other end of the string was attached to float that Yellow was sitting on. Pika makes it but is caught by Lance, who throws him back to Yellow. Lance then tells Yellow about his vendetta against almost all Pokémon Trainers.

==Major events==
Lance destroys Vermilion City.
gives back the 's .
The battle between Blasty and continues.
Lance tells Yellow part of his plan to get rid of humans.
